Speaker: Journal
Text: Travel to Morthal and find Hakan Reed-Walker.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Ask what the marsh returned and what it kept.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Recover Hakan’s red ferry marker from the reedbed scavengers.
Notes: Required before Hakan names his suspect.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Follow Hakan’s suspicion to Hrefna’s farm.
Notes: Map marker appears after the marker is returned.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Search the Stormhollow cellar and reconstruct the Black Sacrament.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Follow the Imperial boot prints to the old watchpost.
Notes: Map marker appears after the farm inspection.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Defeat the soldiers and question the surviving Oculatus scout.
Notes: The scout survives and reveals Hrefna’s camp.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Confront Hrefna at the camp beyond the drowned shrine.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Hear what Hrefna lost before she performed the Sacrament.
Notes: Husband, daughter, farm, and unanswered prayer.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Return to Morthal and expose the trader’s contradictions.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Force Quintus to admit that he is Penitus Oculatus.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Find Quintus’s letter to his daughter and the remaining documents.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Decide whether Quintus stays in the inn or follows the false lead to the farm.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Return to Hrefna and bring her to the inn.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Let Hrefna read the documents and choose Quintus’s fate.
Notes: Three branches: Hrefna kills, Hrefna surrenders, or the Listener kills.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Secure Quintus’s dispatch fragment.
Notes: The documents were found earlier; this objective covers the final evidence review.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Determine what the Oculatus pattern proves—and what it does not.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Decide whether Hrefna belongs in the family.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Record Hrefna’s answer and the Listener’s judgment.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Report what Hrefna chose and what the unanswered Sacrament revealed.

Speaker: Journal
Text: Choose the next name from the Black Ledger.
